patterns.name: Also-bought recommendations for a SKU
patterns.description: Products that co-occur with the given SKU in orders from the last 90 days, ranked by number of orders
patterns.pseudocode: match orders with items.sku = X and ordered_at >= now-90d → unwind items → match items.sku != X → group by items.sku count → sort count desc → limit 10 → lookup products by sku

patterns.name: Products by category
patterns.description: All products in a category sorted by name, paginated
patterns.pseudocode: find category = C → sort name → limit/cursor

patterns.name: Top products last 30 days
patterns.description: Top 10 products by units sold in the last 30 days
patterns.pseudocode: match ordered_at >= now-30d → unwind items → group by sku sum qty → sort desc → limit 10 → lookup products
